content: क्षिप्तिः {%f.%} [क्षिप्-क्तिन्] .²1 Throwing, sending forth. .²2 Explaining a hidden meaning (such as solving riddles). .²3 (in drama) The exposure of a secret. .²4 also {@क्षिप्तिका@} (in <ab>Alg.</ab>) The quantity to be added to the square of the least root multiplied by the multiplicator (to render it capable of yielding an exact square root).
